title: Max Points on a Line
statement_short: Given an array of points where points[i] = [xi, yi] represents a point on the X-Y plane, return the maximum number of points that lie on the same straight line.
constraints: 1 <= points.length <= 300, points[i].length == 2, -10^4 <= xi, yi <= 10^4, all points are unique
hint: Point count up to 300 allows computing pairwise slopes for each point and storing slope frequencies in a hash map in O(n^2) time.
why_not: Right: HashMap / Hash Set computes slope ratios (dy/dx reduced by GCD) for every pair from a fixed point and counts frequencies in O(n^2) time. Not Math / Geometry: Slope calculation uses slope formulas, but tracking point frequencies on identical lines requires a hash map. Not Two Pointers: Sorting by coordinates alone does not group points on non-vertical/horizontal collinear lines. Not Sorting: Sorting angles around a point works, but hash map slope key counting is the standard pattern.
